title: Field to FHIR: synthetic case scenarios
purpose: Eleven synthetic EMS-to-hospital case scenarios. field-to-fhir-data.json is built from these scenarios.

cases.name: Jordan Taylor
cases.emsDx: Suspected myocardial infarction (STEMI pattern on 12-lead ECG)
cases.emsAssessment: Central chest pressure, nausea and diaphoresis; alert and oriented. 12-lead ECG: ST elevation in anterior leads.
cases.emsTreatment: Cardiac monitoring, aspirin per demonstration protocol, IV access, prompt transport.
cases.emsDisposition: Transported emergently to receiving emergency department.
cases.hospitalDx: ST elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI) involving the left anterior descending coronary artery
cases.hospitalCourse: Emergent cardiac catheterization: coronary angiography (low osmolar contrast) showed occlusion of the LAD due to atherosclerotic coronary artery disease; percutaneous coronary intervention with one drug-eluting stent to the LAD. Inpatient cardiology care.
cases.visitReasonStatement: EMS transported the patient to the receiving hospital for the field impression "Suspected myocardial infarction (STEMI pattern on 12-lead ECG)". This EMS impression prompted the hospital evaluation, so the hospital Encounter.reasonReference points to the EMS Condition.

cases.name: Morgan Lee
cases.emsAssessment: Fever, productive cough and tachypnea; SpO2 reduced on room air; focal crackles.
cases.emsTreatment: Oxygen titrated to demonstration target, monitoring, IV access, supportive care.
cases.emsDisposition: Transported to emergency department for respiratory evaluation.
cases.hospitalDx: Pneumonia due to Streptococcus pneumoniae, with hypoxemia
cases.hospitalCourse: Chest imaging showed right lower lobe consolidation; sputum culture grew Streptococcus pneumoniae. Hypoxemia treated with supplemental oxygen; IV antibiotics.
cases.discharge: Discharged home on oral antibiotics with follow-up.
cases.visitReasonStatement: EMS transported the patient to the receiving hospital for the field impression "Suspected lower respiratory infection". This EMS impression prompted the hospital evaluation, so the hospital Encounter.reasonReference points to the EMS Condition.

cases.name: Casey Rivera
cases.chief: Sudden facial droop and unilateral weakness
cases.emsAssessment: New right facial droop, right arm weakness (drift) and slurred speech; last-known-well time documented. Blood glucose normal.
cases.emsTreatment: Stroke screen, glucose check, rapid notification and expedited transport.
cases.hospitalDx: Acute ischemic stroke: cerebral infarction due to thrombosis of the left middle cerebral artery
cases.hospitalCourse: CT/CTA showed left MCA thrombosis. NIH Stroke Scale total score 8. Right hemiparesis (right-hand dominant), aphasia and right facial weakness. IV alteplase given in this hospital's emergency department through a peripheral vein. Inpatient neurologic management.
cases.discharge: Discharged to an inpatient rehabilitation facility.
cases.visitReasonStatement: EMS transported the patient to the receiving hospital for the field impression "Suspected acute stroke". This EMS impression prompted the hospital evaluation, so the hospital Encounter.reasonReference points to the EMS Condition.

cases.name: Avery Brooks
cases.emsAssessment: Tripped on a rug while walking in the kitchen of his single-family home and fell from standing without striking anything; right hip pain, right leg shortened and externally rotated; distal circulation and sensation intact.
cases.emsTreatment: Careful movement, limb support, pain management per demonstration protocol, monitoring.
cases.hospitalDx: Displaced intertrochanteric fracture of the right femur, closed
cases.hospitalCourse: Radiographs confirmed a displaced intertrochanteric fracture of the right femur. Closed reduction of the fracture, then percutaneous internal fixation with an intramedullary (cephalomedullary) nail.
cases.discharge: Discharged to a skilled nursing facility for rehabilitation therapy, with orthopedic follow-up.
cases.visitReasonStatement: EMS transported the patient to the receiving hospital for the field impression "Suspected hip fracture". This EMS impression prompted the hospital evaluation, so the hospital Encounter.reasonReference points to the EMS Condition.

cases.name: Riley Parker
cases.emsAssessment: Known type 1 diabetes on insulin. Confused and diaphoretic, unable to treat herself; fingerstick glucose 42 mg/dL. Severe (level 3) hypoglycemia; treated with IV dextrose.
cases.emsTreatment: Glucose treatment per demonstration protocol, repeat glucose and mental-status checks.
cases.hospitalDx: Type 1 diabetes mellitus with hypoglycemia without coma; hypoglycemia level 3
cases.hospitalCourse: Glucose stabilized; insulin regimen and meal timing reviewed; observed for recurrence.
cases.discharge: Discharged home after glucose stabilized, with diabetes education.
cases.visitReasonStatement: EMS transported the patient to the receiving hospital for the field impression "Symptomatic hypoglycemia". This EMS impression prompted the hospital evaluation, so the hospital Encounter.reasonReference points to the EMS Condition.

cases.name: Cameron Davis
cases.emsAssessment: Right lower quadrant abdominal pain and nausea; localized tenderness.
cases.emsTreatment: Monitoring, IV access and supportive care; no oral intake during transport.
cases.emsDisposition: Transported to emergency department for abdominal evaluation.
cases.hospitalDx: Acute appendicitis with localized peritonitis, without perforation or gangrene
cases.hospitalCourse: CT confirmed acute appendicitis with localized peritonitis; no perforation, no gangrene. Laparoscopic appendectomy.
cases.discharge: Discharged home after postoperative recovery with surgical follow-up.
cases.visitReasonStatement: EMS transported the patient to the receiving hospital for the field impression "Suspected appendicitis". This EMS impression prompted the hospital evaluation, so the hospital Encounter.reasonReference points to the EMS Condition.

cases.name: Taylor Morgan
cases.emsAssessment: Known asthma; wheezing and increased work of breathing (acute asthma exacerbation); severity not known in the field.
cases.emsTreatment: Bronchodilator therapy and oxygen as indicated under demonstration protocol; reassessment.
cases.hospitalDx: Moderate persistent asthma with acute exacerbation
cases.hospitalCourse: Bronchodilators and systemic corticosteroids; monitored until respiratory status improved. Asthma classified as moderate persistent.
cases.discharge: Discharged home with inhaler plan and follow-up.
cases.visitReasonStatement: EMS transported the patient to the receiving hospital for the field impression "Acute asthma exacerbation". This EMS impression prompted the hospital evaluation, so the hospital Encounter.reasonReference points to the EMS Condition.

cases.name: Alex Johnson
cases.chief: Motor vehicle collision with head impact
cases.emsDx: Suspected concussion / mild traumatic brain injury
cases.emsAssessment: Driver of a car in a collision with another car on a local residential street; head impact, headache and brief disorientation; no loss of consciousness; cervical-spine precautions.
cases.emsTreatment: Trauma assessment, appropriate precautions, serial neurologic checks and transport.
cases.emsDisposition: Transported to emergency department for trauma evaluation.
cases.hospitalCourse: CT head: no acute intracranial injury. Serum ethanol 150 mg/dL; alcohol intoxication, uncomplicated. Observed.
cases.discharge: Discharged home with head-injury precautions and follow-up.
cases.visitReasonStatement: EMS transported the patient to the receiving hospital for the field impression "Suspected concussion / mild traumatic brain injury". This EMS impression prompted the hospital evaluation, so the hospital Encounter.reasonReference points to the EMS Condition.

cases.name: Jamie Wilson
cases.emsAssessment: Fever, tachycardia, hypotension and altered mental status.
cases.emsTreatment: Sepsis alert, monitoring, IV access and fluid resuscitation per demonstration protocol.
cases.hospitalDx: Severe sepsis due to Escherichia coli urinary tract infection, with acute metabolic encephalopathy
cases.hospitalCourse: Blood and urine cultures grew Escherichia coli; source urinary tract infection. Acute metabolic encephalopathy as sepsis-related organ dysfunction; no septic shock. IV antibiotics and fluids.
cases.discharge: Discharged to a skilled nursing facility for continued IV antibiotics and rehabilitation.
cases.visitReasonStatement: EMS transported the patient to the receiving hospital for the field impression "Suspected sepsis". This EMS impression prompted the hospital evaluation, so the hospital Encounter.reasonReference points to the EMS Condition.

cases.name: Quinn Harris
cases.chief: Sudden slurred speech and right-sided weakness
cases.emsAssessment: Slurred speech and right-sided weakness; stroke scale positive. Blood glucose not obtained before transport.
cases.emsTreatment: Stroke alert, cardiac monitoring, IV access and rapid transport.
cases.emsDisposition: Transported to emergency department as a stroke alert.
cases.hospitalDx: Type 2 diabetes mellitus with hypoglycemia without coma (stroke mimic), due to glipizide taken as prescribed; hypoglycemia level 3
cases.hospitalCourse: Serum glucose 41 mg/dL on arrival; deficits resolved fully after IV dextrose (level 3 hypoglycemia: altered status requiring assistance). Adverse effect of glipizide taken as prescribed. Long-term oral hypoglycemic use. Stroke alert cancelled.
cases.discharge: Discharged home after glucose stabilized, with diabetes medication review.
cases.visitReasonStatement: EMS transported the patient to the receiving hospital for the field impression "Suspected acute stroke". This EMS impression prompted the hospital evaluation, so the hospital Encounter.reasonReference points to the EMS Condition.

cases.chief: Unresponsive after multi-vehicle crash (mass casualty incident); no identification
cases.emsAssessment: Front-seat passenger in a multi-vehicle crash (car vs car) on an interstate highway; head injury; unresponsive at scene, Glasgow Coma Scale total 6 in the field. Triage tag TAG-0107 applied. No identification found.
cases.emsTreatment: Spinal motion restriction, airway support, rapid transport to trauma center.
cases.emsDisposition: Transported to trauma center under triage tag TAG-0107.
cases.hospitalDx: Traumatic subdural hemorrhage with loss of consciousness of 6 to 24 hours, closed
cases.hospitalCourse: CT showed left acute subdural hematoma; open craniotomy with evacuation of the subdural hematoma. Regained consciousness 14 hours after injury. Registered under alias Copper Heron by triage tag; identified by family on day 2 as Elena Marsh.
cases.discharge: Discharged to an inpatient rehabilitation facility.
cases.visitReasonStatement: EMS transported the patient to the receiving hospital for the field impression "Head injury, unresponsive". This EMS impression prompted the hospital evaluation, so the hospital Encounter.reasonReference points to the EMS Condition.
